name: repro-mask-overlay
description: Owner report: the red mask overlay never goes away. Wanted (Lightroom): it hides once you adjust the mask and shows only while the pointer is over the mask in the panel. Creates a linear gradient with real clicks and a drag, drags its Exposure, and checks the overlay right after the slider moved, with the pointer parked on the picture, while hovering the mask row, and after leaving it. State and pixels are checked separately; pixel checks compare shots of the same edit, so the edit's own effect cannot be mistaken for the overlay.

steps.note: draw the gradient on the picture
the overlay is gone the moment a local slider has moved (state, pointer still on the slider)
park the pointer on the picture, away from the mask panel
after adjusting, with the pointer away, the overlay is hidden (state)
hover the mask in the panel
pixels: hovering the row adds a red tint that was not there right after the slider moved (same edit in both shots)
hovering the mask row shows the overlay (state)
pixels: leaving the row removes the red tint again
pixels: no red tint comes or goes while the pointer is parked on the picture after the adjustment
leaving the row hides it again (state)
